title: ZX Bank Ltd. – Savings Account Overview

nodes.title: Savings Account Features
nodes.summary: Features include competitive interest, zero or low minimum balance options, instant digital onboarding (e-KYC), a free international debit card, mobile app/NetBanking access, UPI and QR payments, reward points on debit transactions, biometric login and card controls with transaction alerts, and a nomination facility.

nodes.title: How to Apply for a ZX Bank Savings Account
nodes.summary: Apply via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app/website (fill details, upload PAN or address proof, complete video or Aadhaar OTP e-KYC, activate in minutes) or at a branch (submit KYC with application form, on-the-spot e-KYC, instant Welcome Kit).

children.title: 1. **Via Mobile App or Website**
children.summary: Download the ZX Bank Asia app or visit www.zxbank.asia, click 'Open Savings Account', fill details and upload PAN/ID and address proof, complete e-KYC via video or Aadhaar OTP, and get an account activated within minutes.

children.title: 2. **At Branch**
children.summary: Visit the nearest ZX Bank branch, submit KYC documents with a duly filled application form, complete on-the-spot e-KYC with staff help, and collect your Welcome Kit instantly.

nodes.title: Minimum Balance Requirements
nodes.summary: Regular Savings requires ₹5,000 (India) or LKR 3,000 (Sri Lanka); Digital Zero Balance is nil; Senior Citizens/Students require ₹1,000 (India). Minimum balance varies by country and variant.

nodes.title: ZX Bank Savings Account Kit
nodes.summary: New savings account holders receive a Welcome Travel Bag, a universal travel adapter supporting 150 countries, a globally accepted EMV chip debit card, passbook and cheque book (optional in digital accounts), and a user guide for activation and card use.

children.title: Kit Includes:
children.summary: The kit includes the welcome travel bag, universal travel adapter for 150 countries or device charging, an internationally accepted EMV chip debit card, optional passbook/cheque book, and a user guide for digital banking and support.

nodes.title: Need Help?
nodes.summary: Contact ZX Bank via the in-app AI virtual assistant 'Zia', by visiting a branch, or through the 24x7 customer care line; more detail on zxbank.asia or the ZX Bank Asia app.
